QuestInfo.name: [Monster Collection] Collecting Monsters!
QuestInfo.0:
Spiegelmann, Maple World's self-acclaimed most famous monster collector, has something to say to you.

#bOnly 1 character per world can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.1:
Collect at least 77 monsters in your Monster Collection.

#bOnly 1 character per world can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2:
You collected 77 monsters and got a #t3017017#!

#bOnly 1 character per world can complete this quest.#k

0.0: Ah, there you are. Does my mustache look extra soft and shiny today? It should, because I'm the master of monster collection! Oh yes, I opened Monster Park by personally collecting special creatures from all over Maple World.\r\n
0.1: Yes, yes, I can see the admiration in your eyes. You want to be like me, don't you, #h0#? A worthy pursuit. To help you along your way, I will give you a gift as a novice monster collector.

yes.0: All you have to do to prove how much you admire me is to #badd 77 monsters to your Monster Collection#k. I'll give you, hmm, let's see, how does an exclusive chair sound?

no.0: Don't be bashful. We all know how much you admire me. Talk to me again when you're ready to express your true feelings.

default.0: You still don't have #b77 monsters in your Monster Collection#k? I guess I really AM spectacular to have collected so many in such short order. Keep trying!
